name: AgentSettingsPageTabbedLayout
description: Settings page shell for configuring one OrgX agent at a time through a tabbed interface, with grouped controls that show descriptions and current values to reduce accidental behavior changes.
usage: Use as the primary surface at /orgx/live for per-agent behavior tuning. Tabs switch the active agent context; each settings group renders label, help text, and current effective value, with unsaved draft deltas shown inline.

props.name: agents
props.type: Array<{ id: string; name: string; role: string; status: 'online' | 'idle' | 'offline'; hasDraftChanges: boolean }>

props.name: groupedSettings
props.type: Array<{ groupId: 'execution' | 'guardrails' | 'reporting'; title: string; description: string; settings: Array<{ key: string; label: string; helpText: string; currentValueLabel: string; draftValueLabel: string | null; state: 'clean' | 'dirty' | 'invalid' }> }>

props.name: validationSummary
props.type: { isValid: boolean; blockingErrors: number; warnings: number }

props.name: onSettingChange
props.type: (agentId: string, key: string, value: unknown) => void

accessibility.notes: Keyboard: tablist uses ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End navigation and keeps Tab for controls inside the active panel; focus order is tablist -> group headings -> controls -> sticky action row. ARIA: tabs use role='tablist'/'tab'/'tabpanel' with aria-controls and aria-selected; each setting help text is linked via aria-describedby; current value badges include text labels ('Current', 'Draft'). Status cannot rely on color alone.

examples: <AgentSettingsPageTabbedLayout agents={agents} activeAgentId='orion' groupedSettings={groups} validationSummary={validation} onSelectAgent={setAgent} onSettingChange={updateSetting} onDiscardDraft={discardDraft} onSaveDraft={saveDraft} />

<AgentSettingsPageTabbedLayout agents={agents} activeAgentId='eli' groupedSettings={groups} validationSummary={{ isValid: false, blockingErrors: 2, warnings: 1 }} onSelectAgent={setAgent} onSettingChange={updateSetting} onDiscardDraft={discardDraft} onSaveDraft={saveDraft} />
dos: Group settings by Execution, Guardrails, and Reporting with a short plain-language description under each group title.
Show current effective value beside editable draft value for every setting so operators can compare before saving.
Keep mobile behavior at 375px with horizontal agent tabs and a sticky 44px-min action row for Discard and Save.
Use existing dashboard tokens for surfaces, spacing, and motion; keep accent usage to one highlight color per element.
donts: Do not hide current values behind hover-only interactions.
Do not mix lime and teal accents on the same badge, button, or field state.
Do not allow Save when blocking validation errors exist.
Do not break tab semantics by rendering non-tab controls inside the tablist container.
